name: GIUSEPPE (JOSEPHO) PUTERI (PUTERO)
bioAdditions: Giuseppe was born on 30 January 1678 (the tree says 1676), son of Ottavio Putero and Vittoria (A)ragona (S1). He married Beatrice Manfrida on 28 August 1709 (S2) and was buried on 13 November 1748 (S3).
